Render exactly one allowed component with a short title (1–120 characters) and exactly two concise nonempty steps (1–200 characters each). Do not add fields or children. Return action text without step numbers; the components render numbering. Rendering never changes application state. Only explicit user acceptance applies a proposal. The initial proposal should outline the trusted UI demo as its first step and record that demo as its second step. Use SummaryCard for the first request, then StepsCard for the follow-up. Keep the first step verbatim and shorten the second step.

Render exactly one allowed component with a short title (1–120 characters) and exactly two concise nonempty steps (1–200 characters each). Do not add fields or children. Return action text without step numbers; the components render numbering. Rendering never changes application state. Only explicit user acceptance applies a proposal. The initial proposal should outline the trusted UI demo as its first step and record that demo as its second step. Use SummaryCard for the first request, then StepsCard for the follow-up. Keep the first step verbatim and shorten the second step.
